sourceText:
Huntington Chicken Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 6, 2009 - 12:33am

Ingredients




3 cups Chicken broth
1 lrg Onion, chopped
1 lrg Bell pepper, chopped
1 pkt (5-oz) noodles
1 jar (4-oz) pimento, chopped
1 can (3-oz) sliced mushrooms
1 cup Grated cheese
Salt & pepper to taste
1 Boiled chicken, deboned, cubed
3 lrg Ribs celery, chopped
1/2 cup Grated cheese, for topping

Preparation

1 Bring chicken broth to a boil; add onion, bell pepper and celery. Boil 15 minutes; add noodles and cook 10 minutes. Add deboned chicken, mushrooms, pimento and cheese. Put into a 2 quart casserole; sprinkle remaining cheese on top. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes. 2 Serves 8 to 10.
